Messages.Author: Myron Mychal
Messages.Body:
I have a Gangrel/Ravnos Fortitude/Animalism deck that makes heavy use of
Owl Companions and also Dawn Operations. If I have a vamp with an Owl
Companion as an ally that is blocked after attempting an action, can
I initiate the ability of the Owl Companion to see the Methuselah's hand
BEFORE I play the Dawn Operation? Or do all action modifiers/reactions
need to be played before the Companion's ability can be utilized?

Myron Mychal

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
In article <36AE2924...@NOSPAMcharlesindustries.com>,


The Owl Companion's ability applies only during combat (card text).
Dawn Operation, since it is an action modifier, must be played before
combat starts. So yes, all action modifiers and reactions that anyone
wants to play must be played before the Owl Companion's ability comes
into effect.

Josh

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Myron Mychal wrote:
> I have a Gangrel/Ravnos Fortitude/Animalism deck that makes heavy use of
> Owl Companions and also Dawn Operations. If I have a vamp with an Owl

> Companion [in his employ] that is blocked after attempting an action, can

> I initiate the ability of the Owl Companion to see the Methuselah's hand
> BEFORE I play the Dawn Operation? Or do all action modifiers/reactions
> need to be played before the Companion's ability can be utilized?

The latter.

The Owl's ability only applies "when ... in combat". And Dawn Operation
must be played before combat.
